programs.title: Rascals
programs.desc: Two gangsters try to attract a beautiful woman in different ways. The first fakes that he spends his money on doing charity. And the other pretends that he is blind to get her heart. Ajay Devgn, Sanjay Dutt, Kangana Ranaut, Lisa Haydon, Arjun Rampal, David Dhawan, Sanjay Chhel.

programs.title: Simmba
programs.desc: A corrupt officer does whatever it takes to break the law no matter what the consequences are. Ranveer Singh, Sara Ali Khan, Sonu Sood, Ashutosh Rana, Siddarth Jadhav, Vaidehi Parshurami, Rohit Shetty, Puri Jagannadh.

programs.title: Love By Force
programs.desc: Naitik and Akshara are forced to marry, while love brings Kartik and Naira together, revealing the difference between love-based relationships and forced marriage. Hina Khan, Karan Mehra.

programs.title: Mannat
programs.desc: Drama Mannat, a gifted chef, works under a boss who is unknowingly her biological mother, and as her dreams for the future collide with the hidden truths of her past, fate begins to reorder her life. Mukta Dhond.

programs.title: The Bitter Harvest
programs.desc: Zeina’s world shifts when she realises Jamshed may not be the man she trusts. As he grows more distant under family pressure, she must fix the cracks before her marriage falls apart. Sanam Saeed, Emmad Irfani.

programs.title: Jhanak
programs.desc: Determined to fulfill her mother's dream of a better life, a young woman faces numerous trials and personal loss, only to have her journey further complicated by a man she meets along the way. Hiba Nawab, Krushal Ahuja.
